[Notes]

[Item cheats: put the cursor on the item and hold ZL + ZR, then:]

[Change Item Quantity: right stick up +1, down -1; Y + R3 deletes the item]

[Augment Slots: Y for 6 weapon slots, A for 4 armor slots]

[Custom Augments: L or R]

[Weather: turn on one weather cheat at a time]
